# Operations review

## Observations

- Warranty claims reached 5,800 this year, of 61,000 units sold.
- Our bet is that photo uploads raise listings sold; a four-week split test will show whether sold listings rise by at least 5%.
- Deliveries run Monday to Saturday, and Saturday slots close at 14:00.
